what: A5's merge gate: does a WebDriver BiDi-driven Firefox clear a real challenge?
answer: Yes, 6/6 — but only with navigator.webdriver hidden. Without it, 0/6.
how: Probed by hand against a real Firefox before any FirefoxBackend existed, so the numbers below come from a scratch harness rather than from solvers.py. Re-run through solvers.py once BidiSolver lands.
note: A BiDi session forces navigator.webdriver true — the WebDriver spec requires it, and dom.webdriver.enabled=false does not override it while a session is open (measured both ways). The only lever is script.addPreloadScript deleting the prototype property, which is patching a surface value rather than not emitting one. That distinction is the open question for A5, not whether it clears.

arms.note: session.new and nothing else. navigator.webdriver reads true on every host.
script.addPreloadScript running `delete Object.getPrototypeOf(navigator).webdriver` before page scripts. Faster than Chrome over CDP on the same hosts, which clears these in 7-9s.
